title: Final Surge Workout Planned TSS Leaderboard
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=finalsurge:workout planned_tss=*
| stats sum(planned_tss) as total_value, avg(planned_tss) as avg_value by plan_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks plan values by total and average planned tss across Final Surge workout events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `planned_tss` values for each Final Surge workout event and review total and average planned tss by plan.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total planned tss.
grandmaExplanation: It can tell which plan shows the biggest planned tss numbers in your Final Surge workout data.
